      "explanation":"household",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"A legitimate new household member could share the home shipping address with other accounts. The address is too newly registered to qualify for the household exception."
    },

      "explanation":"synthetic_identity",
      "likelihood":"low",
      "reasoning":"A newly opened account shipping to an address shared by several accounts could reflect coordinated identities. Matching payment geography, successful verification results and no device or email duplication weaken that explanation."

  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"R08 holds because the shipping address serves three accounts. Although it is the customer's home, its newly registered status prevents the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule condition holds, and no earlier outcome settles the order. A legitimate household member is a plausible competing explanation, but address sharing alone cannot establish fraud. No verification check has run. Recommend needs_check with id_check under §6.6(b); decline is not permitted with only Linkage present. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support the recommendation."
